route_selection_method.decision_rule: Select at most one route that directly addresses the empty native-candidate pool, has source-bound justification, can terminate in bounded pass/block/failure, and does not adopt an action or principle. Other utility does not override failure to address the native-selection gap.

route_comparison.reason: It addresses the precise missing object: a positive ToE-native reason that can constrain or generate an action family without pretending that a preserved candidate already exists.

route_comparison.reason_not_selected: It would move directly to invented action content before testing whether accepted ToE architecture supplies a positive selection principle; retain only as a separately authorized fallback after a principled derivation blocks or fails.
It can support separately authorized work but does not answer why Einstein-Hilbert is the ToE's native law and therefore cannot be the primary resolution of the empty native-candidate pool.
The survey identifies a specific bounded missing basis rather than only an undifferentiated dependency set, so indefinite deferral is not yet justified.
A source-justified positive-principle derivation route is ready to be proposed separately, so a no-route conclusion would discard a concrete bounded next question.

selected_route_rationale: The accepted survey shows a complete evaluation envelope but no positive native law and no eligible preserved action. A bounded attempt to derive a positive native gravitational principle is therefore the narrowest route that attacks the exact missing basis without postulating an action prematurely.
selected_route_remaining_prerequisites: freeze the source-bound native ontology and architecture inputs permitted to support a positive principle
distinguish derivation from a new postulate and from known-physics recovery assumptions
define what action-basis restriction or selection power would count as nontrivial
freeze pass block and failure outcomes before executing any principle derivation
selected_route_may_prepare: a separately reviewed bounded-program proposal for positive native gravitational principle derivation
source and dependency inventories for that proposal
nontrivial selection-power and falsification criteria for that proposal
selected_route_may_not_claim: a native gravitational principle has been selected or derived
a gravitational action has been invented selected varied or adopted
quadratic gravity is promoted beyond reference control
a successor program is authorized installed or opened
a gravitational calculation or empirical validation has occurred

future_route_pass_block_failure_meaning.pass: A source-bound positive native principle is derived with explicit nontrivial constraints that reduce or select an admissible gravitational action basis and can support a separate action-construction handoff.
future_route_pass_block_failure_meaning.block: The preserved native ontology and architecture do not contain enough physical content to formulate a positive gravitational principle without adding a new postulate.
future_route_pass_block_failure_meaning.fail: The tested principle only restates generic consistency or known-physics recovery, conflicts with accepted project architecture, or provides no action-basis discrimination.

scientific_conclusion: No preserved source-defined native gravitational action family is eligible for selection. The next justified research route is to prepare, under separate authority, a bounded derivation test for a positive native gravitational principle.
